question: 论文如何评估领域随机化与生成数据对鲁棒性的作用？

gold_quotes.quote: To enhance policy robustness to real-world variability, we apply domain randomization along five dimensions: (1) cluttered distractor objects, (2) background textures, (3) lighting conditions, (4) tabletop heights, and (5) diverse language instructions.
With a mix of large-scale synthetic data and only 10 real demonstrations, a vision–language–action (VLA) model achieves a 367% relative improvement over the 10-demo baseline.

Even without real data, zero-shot models trained solely on synthetic data obtain a 228% relative gain, highlighting the effectiveness of our dataset in strengthening sim-to-real transfer and robustness to environmental variations.

We evaluate performance with four metrics: ASR (Average Success Rate), Top5-ASR (success over the top-5 candidates per task), CR-Iter (average refinement iterations before termination), and Token (average number of tokens in generated policy code).
